skills.name: github-marketplace-action-publish
skills.when_to_use: Publish or update a GitHub Actions Marketplace listing
required_inputs: public repo root action.yml with branding
sequence: Marketplace checkbox via BrowserOS neo after Developer Agreement
Verify LIVE before any LIVE claim
skills.validate: verify-listing.js exit 0 against slug derived from action.yml name
skills.return: LIVE URL, uses snippet, tag SHA, ECI free-only vs paid-paused
skills.approval_boundary: Draft-stop before paid Marketplace plans, enterprise-claim expansion, or buyer outreach. Free listing of the existing Action is in-skill.

skills.name: verify-github-marketplace-listing
skills.when_to_use: Is the Action on Marketplace / LIVE / 404 / advertise the listing
access: no token required for public listing pages
sequence: Classify live vs not-live vs unknown
skills.validate: HTTP 200 + real title, not a GitHub 404 page. Exit 1 is unknown, not missing.
skills.return: JSON live, listing.url, listing.http, listing.title, listing.uses, search.hasSlug
skills.approval_boundary: Read-only. Never publish, edit a release, or post.

skills.name: advertise-thumbgate-github-marketplace
skills.when_to_use: Cite the Marketplace listing when advertising ThumbGate
sequence: If counsel_clearance is false, cite free listing only
Return URL + uses snippet from verify JSON
skills.validate: Same-turn live=true and listing.http=200. No stale vault notes.
skills.return: Listing URL, title, uses snippet, ECI free-cite-only
skills.approval_boundary: Do not invent paid plans, pilot CTAs, or buyer outreach. Cite only.

routines.name: weekly-thumbgate-marketplace-live-check
routines.schedule_or_event: weekday phrase match: marketplace listing / is ThumbGate on Marketplace; optional weekly Mon 09:00 after a second live test
routines.expected_result: JSON live=true or an explicit NOT LIVE / UNKNOWN with http status
routines.approval_boundary: Read-only verify. Stop before publish, social post, or paid-plan changes.
routines.missing_source_policy: If the probe errors or times out, report UNKNOWN — do not invent LIVE or missing
routines.stale_data_policy: Refetch every run; never reuse a previous session snapshot; mark stale if evidence is not from this invocation
routines.partial_completion_report: Always report listing.http + title; if search fails, say search skipped and still use listing as truth
